claims.statement: Steam Engine preserves Efest IMR 26650 3500mAh 32A as a 3500mAh preset with a 32A runtime rating.

The tested 2014 Efest IMR 26650 3500mAh revision has a purple wrapper, raised/button-top terminal, and no protection circuit; it is a nominal 26 mm x 65 mm cylindrical cell. Independent testing found the printed 32A/64A ratings substantially overstated.

The Efest IMR 26650 catalog entry is a branded rewrap or protected branded cell marketed in an IMR/INR/ICR-family lithium-ion context, but the exact cathode chemistry and underlying OEM were not established.
The exact catalog entry Efest IMR 26650 has reliable market-introduction evidence dated 2014-12-03 or earlier.
